description: Install and connect the Backsies WordPress plugin on a hosted WordPress site (action connect), or disconnect it (action disconnect). Confirm required. Returns a proposal + confirmToken; call oma_confirm_tool next.

action.description: connect (default) installs the plugin; disconnect revokes its key.

domain.description: Site domain, e.g. example.fi, instead of serviceId.

serviceId.description: OMA hosting service id. Pass this or domain.

name: oma_backsies_wp_connect
title: Connect Backsies WordPress plugin
